text: An aircraft has just taken off. The crew is expecting to turn right and proceed to waypoint Yankee Bravo, which is the exit point on the SID. As they pass 600 meters, Departure Control instructs them to turn right and proceed direct to Vinny, a waypoint that the crew doesn't understand or recognize. So the crew decides to contact Departure Control. Why does the crew need to contact Departure Control?
